about: Fixed labeled corpus for recall-eval.spec.ts. Change it only deliberately: metrics are comparable across retrieval changes only on the same corpus. 'owner' writes the personal and shared memories; 'outsider' is another user whose decoys share keywords and must never be returned.

ranking.about: Recall-ranking cases (date filter and cross-vault fusion), scored by the second test in recall-eval.spec.ts on their own users, so the main corpus and its metrics stay as they were. A memory's 'occurred_at' goes to memory_write; a query's 'time_range' to recall; 'excluded' memories must never be returned; vault 'all' recalls with no vault_id (personal and shared ranked together).
